product_overview: Born Citius is a web-based system for managing field-work job cards, task assignments, review workflows, and final document generation for telco/ISP operations. It lets admins and supervisors build dynamic forms and output layouts, assign work to technicians, review submissions, and export approved documents as PDF or Word.
core_goals: Log in and access the task management dashboard
Create and maintain reusable task templates
Create and maintain reusable output layouts for document generation
Assign tasks to technicians within folders
Review submitted tasks field-by-field and send revisions back when needed
Approve completed tasks and export final documents
Manage application users and account status

features.name: Login
features.description: Allows authorized admin and supervisor users to sign in with email and password and reach the application dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form with technician role -> See inline access rejection message

features.name: Logout
features.description: Allows a signed-in user to end the session and return to the public login screen.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the user menu -> Choose logout -> See the login screen

features.name: Dashboard Summary
features.description: Shows a read-only overview of task counts by status, per-folder breakdowns, and overdue tasks for the signed-in user role.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review task status counts and folder breakdown -> Open an overdue task from the list -> See the task review page
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review task status counts and folder breakdown -> Open a folder from the summary -> See the folder task list

features.name: Folder List
features.description: Lets the user browse client folders and open a folder to view its task list.
user_flows: Navigate to /folders -> Review the folder list and task counts -> Open a folder -> See the folder task list

features.name: Folder Detail — Task List, Search & Bulk Actions
features.description: Lets the user search, filter, select, review, delete, and bulk delete tasks inside a folder.
user_flows: Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Search by task data -> Adjust status filters -> Select tasks -> Delete selected tasks -> See the updated task list
Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Open a task for review -> See the task review page
Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Delete one task -> Confirm deletion -> See the updated task list
Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Select multiple eligible tasks -> Choose bulk delete -> Confirm deletion -> See the updated task list

features.name: Assign Task Dialog
features.description: Allows the user to create a new task instance inside a folder from an existing template and assign it to a technician.
user_flows: Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Start assigning a task -> Select a template -> Select a technician -> Enter optional site or store code -> Enter a due date -> Submit the task assignment -> See the new task in the folder list
Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Start assigning a task -> Omit a required field -> Submit the task assignment -> See validation feedback

features.name: Bulk Import Tasks via Excel
features.description: Allows the user to create many task instances at once by downloading an Excel template, filling it, uploading it, reviewing parsed rows, and submitting the batch.
user_flows: Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Start bulk import -> Select a template -> Download the Excel template -> Fill the spreadsheet offline -> Upload the completed file -> Review the parsed preview rows -> Submit the batch -> See per-row creation results
Navigate to /folders -> Open a folder -> Start bulk import -> Upload an unsupported file format -> See an upload error message

features.name: Task Template List
features.description: Lets the user browse task templates and open the template builder for creation or editing.
user_flows: Navigate to /templates -> Review the template list -> Open a template -> See the template builder
Navigate to /templates -> Start creating a new template -> See the new template builder

features.name: Form Builder (Create/Edit Template)
features.description: Lets the user create or edit a task template by defining fields, required flags, sections, ordering, and active state.
user_flows: Navigate to /templates/new -> Enter a template name -> Toggle the active state -> Add a field -> Select the field -> Configure label, type, section, options, and required status -> Reorder fields -> Duplicate or remove fields -> Save the template
Navigate to /templates/:templateId -> Review the existing template structure -> Add or edit fields -> Reorder fields -> Save the template

features.name: Output Layout List
features.description: Lets the user browse output layouts and open the layout builder for creation or editing.
user_flows: Navigate to /layouts -> Review the layout list -> Open a layout -> See the layout builder
Navigate to /layouts -> Start creating a new layout -> See the new layout setup flow

features.name: Layout Builder — Blocks, Drag-and-Drop, Save
features.description: Lets the user build a printable output layout by selecting a source template, adding blocks, reordering them, editing their properties, and saving the layout.
user_flows: Navigate to /layouts/new -> Select a source template -> Enter a layout name -> Toggle the default setting -> Add layout blocks -> Drag blocks to reorder them -> Edit block properties -> Save the layout
Navigate to /layouts/:layoutId -> Review the existing layout canvas -> Add, duplicate, move, or remove blocks -> Edit block properties -> Save the layout

features.name: Layout AI Assistant
features.description: Lets the user upload a reference document or chat with an AI assistant to receive suggested layout blocks that can be applied or discarded.
user_flows: Navigate to /layouts/:layoutId -> Open the AI assistant tab -> Upload a PDF or image reference -> Review the generated suggestion -> Apply the suggestion to the canvas -> Save the layout
Navigate to /layouts/:layoutId -> Open the AI assistant tab -> Enter an instruction prompt -> Send the prompt -> Review the suggestion -> Discard the suggestion
Navigate to /layouts/:layoutId -> Open the AI assistant tab -> Apply a suggestion -> Undo the last applied suggestion -> See the canvas revert

features.name: Task Review & Approval
features.description: Lets the reviewer inspect a task, approve or reject fields, edit values directly, send the task back to the technician, approve all eligible fields, and export the final document.
user_flows: Navigate to /tasks/:taskId -> Review field values -> Approve individual fields -> Edit a field directly -> Reject a field with a required comment -> Send the task back to the technician -> See the task marked for revision
Navigate to /tasks/:taskId -> Review field values -> Approve every non-section field -> Approve all -> See the task marked approved
Navigate to /tasks/:taskId -> Open an attachment -> View the file in a new tab -> Remove an attachment -> See the updated task content
Navigate to /tasks/:taskId -> Open an approved task -> Export PDF -> Download the final PDF
Navigate to /tasks/:taskId -> Open an approved task -> Export Word -> Download the final Word document

features.name: User Management
features.description: Lets the user create accounts, change active status, and reset passwords for admin, supervisor, and technician users.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> Start adding a user -> Enter name, email, and role -> Set or regenerate a password -> Submit the form -> See the new user and the one-time password reveal
Navigate to /users -> Open a user actions menu -> Deactivate the account -> See the account marked inactive
Navigate to /users -> Open a user actions menu -> Activate the account -> See the account marked active
Navigate to /users -> Open a user actions menu -> Start password reset -> Regenerate or edit the password -> Submit the reset -> See the one-time password reveal

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, Server Components)
xlsx (client-side Excel parsing for bulk task import)
httpOnly cookie session (bc_access/bc_refresh), no client-side token storage

Read-only summary of task status counts, per-folder breakdown, and overdue tasks
List of client folders with task counts

known_limitations.issue: No client-side role-based access control anywhere in the app — sidebar nav and page actions are identical for admin and spv; permission differences only surface as API errors (403) at request time
known_limitations.impact: Negative-permission test cases must be driven by API responses per logged-in role, not by asserting hidden/disabled UI elements

known_limitations.issue: /users page has no error handling around its GET /users call (unlike /folders/[folderId], which catches the same call and falls back to an empty list for SPV)
known_limitations.impact: If an SPV role is forbidden from listing users server-side, this page likely throws/500s instead of degrading gracefully — needs a dedicated test

known_limitations.issue: No folder create/edit/delete UI found anywhere in this app
known_limitations.impact: Folder creation must happen outside this admin UI (or is not yet implemented here); do not write "create folder" UI test cases

known_limitations.issue: Form builder field reordering uses up/down buttons, not drag-and-drop, unlike the Layout builder which uses real dnd-kit drag-and-drop
known_limitations.impact: Do not test drag interactions on /templates/*; only /layouts/* has draggable blocks

known_limitations.issue: AI layout suggestion undo only stores a single previous state, not a full history
known_limitations.impact: Applying two AI suggestions in a row before undoing overwrites the undo snapshot of the first — a double-apply-then-undo test would reveal this

known_limitations.issue: Excel bulk-import parses files entirely client-side; malformed-but-parseable rows are only caught by the server on final submit
known_limitations.impact: Test both a non-.xlsx/.csv file (client-side generic error toast) and a well-formed-but-invalid-data file (server-side per-row error reporting)

known_limitations.issue: PDF export has a 120s max duration and performs two sequential upstream calls (generate, then fetch); Word export is a single call
known_limitations.impact: Good candidate for a slow-network/timeout test case
